enum PlaygroundRepresentation : UInt8 {
  case Class = 1
  case Struct = 2
  case Tuple = 3
  case Enum = 4
  case Aggregate = 5
  case Container = 6
  case IDERepr = 7
  case Gap = 8
  case ScopeEntry = 9
  case ScopeExit = 10
  case Error = 11
  case IndexContainer = 12
  case KeyContainer = 13
  case MembershipContainer = 14
  case Unknown = 0xFF
  static func fromByte(byte : UInt8) -> PlaygroundRepresentation {
    let repr /*
*/= PlaygroundRepresentation(rawValue: byte)
    if repr == .none { return .Unknown } else { return repr! }
}
}
}
